notes.title: August 2018 11 Update
notes.notes:
For so long time we made a big adjustment, the entire game structure has been optimized to be suitable for both single player and multi-player game
The hall is divided into 3 modules: the puzzle of wealth, the cloud of blocks, and the battle of stock gods.
The puzzle of wealth is divided into 6 modules: the transition from simple to difficult.
Increase the rank of the rich, from the common people to the world's rich, different ranks correspond to different investment success rates
The initial social module is relatively simple, allowing beginners to familiarize themselves with games quickly.
Investment wars and rural growth modules increased business wars and loans
The famous town has increased stock trading and business opportunities.
Egypt time increased the roulette and stock rights issue
The richers of Paris increased investment in fixed buildings, courts and civil affairs bureaus
The battle of gods is a simplified version of simulated stock investment
The content of the game is more, hoping to give the players who like the game or are more interested in financial management some fun.
